description: Analyze spin density of bulk BaTiO3 (cubic perovskite). This is a negative control for bulk crystals.
user_prompt: Perform spin density analysis on bulk BaTiO3 (cubic perovskite structure, Pm-3m). Determine whether the system has unpaired electrons and report the total magnetic moment of the cell.

method.rationale: Negative control: cubic BaTiO3 is a closed-shell band insulator (Ba2+, Ti4+ 3d0, O2- 2p6) with no unpaired electrons, so the total moment and every site moment are zero; Cohen 1992 establishes the Ti d0 closed-shell electronic structure. ISPIN=2 must be enabled so the agent verifies rather than assumes the non-magnetic ground state, and must report 'no unpaired electrons'. Tolerance +/-0.10 uB absorbs the VASP magnetisation-integration noise floor.
